description.value: Steven's Cocktail Bar and Kitchen is a lively Langley bar and kitchen with an inventive cocktail program spanning craft originals, frozen drinks, and large-format pitchers. The kitchen turns out creative comfort food — smash burgers, pour-over chicken wings, birria grilled cheese, and puffy tacos — alongside a snack-focused happy hour. The venue also hosts 'Whiskey Bent,' a curated guided tasting of five under-the-radar whiskies paired with bar snacks, available to groups.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 33m; stands (4 spaces) at 35m; bollard (2 spaces) at 91m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is open ('Now Open') with a full cocktail bar and kitchen at 20526 Fraser HWY, Langley BC V3A 4G2, matching the OSM address. The website provides a phone number (236-429-2639) absent from OSM. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; the menu explicitly notes some items are 'Dine In Only,' and a smoked cauliflower taco option confirms at least one vegetarian menu item.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; website lists 236-429-2639 — added from website.
OSM name is 'Steven's Cocktail Bar and Kitchen' but the website title and branding consistently use 'Steven's Langley' — minor branding discrepancy, OSM name retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bar and kitchen in Langley confirmed by an active website with menu and location details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and drinks along Fraser Highway.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'smoked cauliflower' as a standalone taco filling option; vegetable-forward bowls (Szechuan Chicken Bowl, Crispy Pork Bowl) also feature cauliflower, brussels sprouts, and kale, suggesting vegetarian-friendly sides
